data.gender_notes: Erinn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Erinn is derived from the Irish word 'Eirinn', meaning 'land of the eternals' or 'radiant one'. It is believed to have been used as a byname for the goddess Ériu in pre-Christian Ireland. The name Erinn carries the meaning “Eternal, Radiant One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erinn usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal, radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of eternal life and radiant beauty.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erinn total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
